terminalHint: Font, theme and Persian rendering checks for the terminal you already use.
playwrightSummary: Browser tests, including assertions that Persian text is right-aligned and code stays left-to-right.
repowiseSummary: Compress noisy test, build and git output, score change risk, and check code health.
repowiseHint: The wiki index is per repository, so check it in your project with repowise status. A zero page count leaves context and search empty until you initialise it.
superpowersSummary: A plugin of working-method skills for your agent: brainstorming, plans, test-driven development and systematic debugging.
superpowersHint: Superpowers installs through the agent's plugin marketplace; the status check looks at the local plugin cache.
browsersMissing: No Edge or Chrome found; run npx playwright install once.
playwrightHint: Playwright itself is installed per project (npm i -D @playwright/test).
hindsightSummary: Persistent project memory: keeps per-repo decisions and knowledge pages and feeds them back while the agent works.
dshSummary: DSH workspace hygiene: assesses intermediate-file value and recommends keep, remove and relocate.
ponytailSummary: The shortest solution that works: forces the agent to the simplest viable answer; anti-bloat.
uiuxSummary: Design and review interfaces with searchable styles, palettes, typography and UX guidelines.
unslopSummary: Removes repetitive AI writing patterns so text reads human and natural.
